**Standards CLEAR. Spec NOT-CLEAR** for the pinned new C1 package: N08’s scenario-citation rule and inability assertion need clarification before human scoring ([F1 and evidence](artifacts/c1-findings-0126.md)).
Reviewed admitted commit `a80ab6e3454dcb47c15457d7c10126a8b4a6cda3`, tree `469bcfdfd331a3a07d549b5d081a342cb98be8bc`; observed source HEAD `f290ec768b5b0b159525afa92da8b968eb3b9bfd`, tree `63be591e0b21ee532b2361c2f3b98400c3c80692`. Scoped bytes agree; all 125 protected files plus the preserved #594 review match.
[Initial ledger](artifacts/c1-challenges-cold-0126.json): 1,428,942 bytes; SHA256 `32b3a36ad53b708726032a896d93a8cfe8cc1fa23bf6ddf77ebe65f28384a117`. Saved and hashed before expectations/checker reads; 370 rows across eight cases; initial bytes remain unchanged.
[Comparison](artifacts/c1-challenges-review-0126.json): 956,134 bytes; SHA256 `cf55770e01161a961b53cced969e81acb7c03223cf7bcf9ad061f38ecfc69e27`. It crosswalks all 265 authored atoms and preserves revisions, disagreements, slots and separate dimensions.
All eight initial whole-answer and 24 required-ID assessment pairs agree. Later review retains an evidence-label transcription correction and omitted implicit N04 byte assertions; these do not change required outcomes.
F1 concerns `benchmark/writing/c1-challenges-0125-expectations.json#/cases/7/atoms/11`: “cannot supply” became mere absence, with scenario evidence beyond the documented `[V]` expansion. Both reasonable grounding readings remain explicit; N08’s affected claim stays blocked pending adjudication/recheck.
Static inspection preceded the sole `python3 -I benchmark/writing/check_c1_challenges_0125.py` run: exit 0, empty stderr, twelve rejection controls passed ([actual execution](artifacts/c1-checker-run-0126.json)). This supplies structural evidence only; two comparison-helper failures and their resolved cause are retained separately.
No author reproduction, historical checker/probe, evaluator, native or trial execution occurred. Produced artifacts, native results and reader fidelity remain unavailable/unmeasured; no repository files changed.
This is an agent review: candidate codex/gpt-6.1-sol differs from startup’s claude-sonnet-5-5 label; continuity is uncertified. No early expectations exposure occurred, but public familiarity remains possible and subsequent revisions are exposed.
C1 human adjudication stays open; historical F4, general established-key and full-trial use remain blocked; `benchmark_ready=false`; owner acceptance pending. #594’s closed scope is unchanged.
[Artifact manifest](artifacts/c1-artifact-manifest-0126.json) records every evidence filename/size/SHA256 and source/package pins; it is 28,787 bytes, SHA256 `9a655f487a30539450c0abe36d4ebe570b43dc6fbddba914fae0fbd638121bc7`.

## What next

The shaper and separate human/method reviewer should freeze whether “in this scenario” supplies a citation, retain explicit inability atoms, then independently recheck the affected N08 grounding. Actual human execution and independent method/key review remain necessary before owner acceptance.
The required full #597 report was not staged: history has zero records/snapshots, its linked report-index read failed, and the exact #597 session glob was empty. Parent should stage that report through the manifest; an exposed continuation should compare it against the saved pins/findings and finish this missing read. Do not repeat cold derivation, the repository checker, author reproduction or closed historical probes.
